name: Dolní Dvůr (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part and a red lower fly part, with a yellow shield bearing crossed black miners' hammers and two green spruces over the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 28 November 2000 (decision No. 74) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
